description: This file defines a utility function `shapeStackedSeries` that processes a list of cost records to produce a dataset suitable for stacked chart visualizations, specifically formatted for Recharts. It organizes data based on a specified dimension ('environment' or 'cost_category') and fills in zeroes for missing categories, enabling consistent stacking visuals.

methods.name: shapeStackedSeries(records, stackBy = "environment", options)
methods.description: Transforms raw cost records into a structured dataset suitable for stacked visualizations, grouping by the specified dimension and ensuring all categories are represented with zero-filling where necessary.
